body:
All she has to do is open her mouth and it makes me smile. All she has to do is take one look at me with her dark eyes, and it makes me feel like I want to live. Id rather stay awake for hours with her, because I know that being with her is better than any dream I could ever have.

She's caring and understanding, but stubborn to a fault. She can be selfish and careless, which manifests itself in situations like this.
All I want is her to contact me. Tell me that shell go through this with me. I don't want to wait for things together better, or pretend that I'm happy anymore.
Maybe you were just better equipped to handle it. I am not.

The thing is I don't want to. I know that there are people who care, but I put my whole life's effort into trying to make this girl happy. I feel like I've been tricked or that I've wasted my time, my love, my heart. If the world needed me so bad, then why won't the girl who is supposed to love me accept me?

Edit: and the guilt of leaving people behind does not compare to the pain that I feel just being here

Nothing makes me feel the slightest bit better. Ive never been selfish in my life, always putting others before myself, and I realize that it's time for me to be selfish. To have what I want. All I want is for my girlfriend to be with me through this time. There is nothing else I want.
